review.rationale: Primary sources independently reviewed for narrow capability support, practical trial criteria and explicit privacy or provider limits. Volatile documentation requires re-observation after 90 days.

reasons.relevance: Directly addresses finding repository code when exact names are unknown; enforced snippet budgeting remains outside its supported scope.
reasons.evidence: Current first-party documentation supports semantic indexes, index status and rebuild controls, relevant code sections and non-GitHub upload restrictions.
reasons.usefulness: A pinned public-repository trial checks two genuine questions, cited lines, omissions and further reads against keyword search.
reasons.clarity: Explicitly excludes a guaranteed snippet cap, standalone retrieval API, completeness and local-only behavior; cataloging grants no upload authority.

need.query: How can I retrieve relevant repository code when I do not know its exact names?

claims.text: Copilot uses semantic repository or workspace indexes for meaning-based code context. VS Code documents indexing status and an explicit index rebuild command.
GitHub documents indexed repository context and references to relevant code sections. Non-GitHub workspace indexing sends content to GitHub and has account and policy restrictions.

candidates.name: Evaluate native semantic repository context
candidates.reason: For a separately authorized trial on a pinned public repository, ask two real questions with unfamiliar naming, request a small snippet set, verify cited lines and record omissions and further reads. Compare with narrow keyword search.
limitations: Documentation supplies no caller-enforced snippet or token cap, standalone retrieval API or completeness guarantee. Opened or selected ignored files can enter context. No private workspace was uploaded and no candidate was executed; strict bounded retrieval and local-only behavior remain unproved.
Primary-source capability evidence; usefulness and comparative trial results are unmeasured. Cataloging grants no execution or upload authority.
